scope: Three-phase tow stochastic scalar progressive-damage prototype; no validated CMC fracture or mesh-objectivity claim.
assumptions: The phase-wise maximum principal virgin stress over eight Gauss points drives scalar irreversible damage, quantized into 32 declared states.
Characteristic length is the cube root of voxel volume. Linear softening integrates to specified G in homogeneous uniaxial continuum loading before damage quantization and residual stiffness.
Residual stiffness, damage quantization and isotropic bulk PyC are explicit numerical/model assumptions. This is not a cohesive debonding, fiber pull-out, or validated multiaxial CMC failure law.
The old T300/epoxy parameters and old MMF catalog are not used.
